description: MainActivity.kt defines the MainActivity class for an Android Tic Tac Toe app. It manages UI rendering, user interactions, accessibility features, and observes a ViewModel for game state. The code sets focus navigation, handles cell taps, restart functionality, and displays outcome dialogs.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity manages the UI for the Tic Tac Toe game, including rendering the board, handling user interactions, accessibility features, and observing game state via ViewModel.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, focus navigation, event handlers, and restores state.

methods.name: renderBoard
methods.description: Updates the Tic Tac Toe board UI, applies animations for new moves, and highlights winning lines.

methods.name: renderStatus
methods.description: Updates the status TextView to reflect the current player's turn, winner, or draw, with animated color transitions.

methods.name: maybeShowOutcome
methods.description: Displays a dialog announcing the game outcome and handles user restart actions.

methods.name: announceForAccessibility
methods.description: Public method to announce messages for accessibility; uses View.announceForAccessibility when available.

methods.name: rowFromIndex
methods.description: Calculates the row number (1-3) from a board index.

methods.name: colFromIndex
methods.description: Calculates the column number (1-3) from a board index.
